steps.caption: Open Requirements in the sidebar and choose the Nimbus Ledger Pune office.
The Intelligence panel says this requirement has 4 changes. Open it.
Current requirement: each field with how sure we are — confirmed, our estimate or unknown.
Unknown fields, like seats and decision date, stay 'Unknown' until the client tells you.
What changed: every difference between versions, newest first.
Area: 10,000 → 15,000 sq ft. The old value is crossed out but kept.
Budget and preferred locations changed too (Hinjewadi → Kharadi).
Each line says which version (v1→v2) and why: a call with Kavita — headcount grew after funding.
Recommendations: refresh the shortlist and comparison, because they were built on the old brief.
Previous property options and rejection reasons stay with the requirement.
Open the full timeline for this requirement.
The timeline shows the requirement change as one event with all differences and the version it came from.
An old value counts as obsolete only when the client confirmed the new one; otherwise it is 'superseded, not confirmed yet'.
